description: Active in-stock simple product, searchable on the store, no required add-ons, whose active price for the profile has a sales price above zero and below the retail price, and that no automatic promotion discounts for it. KB: Custom Price Lists; Product Types.

quantityUsed.description: Quantity the test adds to cart

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

profile.description: Profile name the test shops as (e.g. Anonymous for a guest): its price lists on the store come first, then the store's; no automatic promotion for it may discount the product
